rca_of_issue: Reproduction: run `yarn test:unit tests/use_gptour_commercial.test.ts`. Failing case is 'conversation Rozzano→09:00→Opera→remove new...'. At first turn, expected commercialGroups.inactiveDays=20 from exact user text '...da20giorni...', but received inactiveDays=null after hook send merge path. This indicates compact token parsing/retention gap for no-space threshold forms in real conversation pipeline. Mitigation: normalize compact day tokens before/inside purchase threshold extraction used by conversation rules, then preserve threshold across merge/applyConversationRules turns.
